nel list (local Harness bundle).
# Beads panel for DeepSeek Harness

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that
puts Beads into the Web GUI's left
sidebar panel list.
The panel works on a Harness workspace's Beads database (`bd`):

- **Ready / In progress / Open / All** filters over the workspace's beads.
- Inline detail for one b

ead: description, notes, dependencies, metadata, and comments.
- **New bead** form (title, priority,

type).
- **Claim** and **Close** actions on the selected bead.
- Graceful states for "bd is not ins
talled" and "this workspace is not a `bd init` project yet".
## About Beads

Beads is a distributed, dependency-aware
issue tracker for AI agents, powered by Dolt. Agents use th

e `bd` CLI
(`bd ready`, `bd update --claim`, `bd close`) to keep a structured memory
instead of mark

down TODO lists. This plugin reads and writes that same database;
it does not copy state anywhere.
## How it is built
| Half | File | Responsibility |
| Host | `index.js` | Serves `GET/POST /__dsh_beads/api` (owner-authenticated). Resolves a registere
d workspace id through the Host workspace registry and runs one fixed `bd` invocation per action. |
| Client | `client.js` | Registers the `beads` entry in `sidebar.panellist` and the matching `main`
panel. Renders the list, detail, and forms; every data operation goes through the Host half. |

The Browser half never runs a shell: a request can only select one of the closed
actions `status`, `

issues`, `issue`, `create`, `claim`, and `close`, and only the
Host owns the workspace directory and
the `bd` argument vectors.

## Use

- The panel inspects workspaces registered with the Harness, and remembers the
last one you picked.

Run `bd init` in the workspace to create its Beads
database.
- `bd` is looked up through the Host su

bprocess service first, then
`/opt/homebrew/bin/bd`, `/usr/local/bin/bd`, `~/.local/bin/bd`, and
`/u

sr/bin/bd` (set `BEADS_BIN` to override).
- Write actions are queued because embedded Dolt allows on

e writer.
- The UI is localized (English and Simplified Chinese), uses only Harness theme
tokens, an
d ships its own icon.
